name: sethu
description: Run terminal commands from Claude Code's prompt box. Commands execute directly in your shell, bypassing Claude Code's per-command permission prompts — read-only by default; writing commands need an explicit allowlist.

plugins.name: sethu
plugins.description: Run commands from the prompt box: `> cmd` runs it in your shell and blocks the model (zero tokens), `>> cmd` also pipes output to Claude. Executes WITHOUT Claude Code's per-command permission prompts — read-only by default; writes require `sethu --allow`.
